description:
## Problem
benchbox-site PR #163 (https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site/pull/163) adds a docs note that DuckDB 1.x and 2.x use different database file formats, following the lift of BenchBox's DuckDB `<2.0.0` pin. It is a draft with all checks passing and has waited for owner review since the pin lift.

## Decision gate (owner only)
Approve and mark ready (agents then arm and merge per the site repo's process), request changes (agents revise), or close. Agents do not mark it ready, approve it, or merge it without the owner's decision in that task.

## Guardrails
No site deploy outside the repo's normal merge path. Facts in the note must match DuckDB's storage compatibility docs at review time; re-check before merge.
